plugin.name: Game icons
plugin.description: Add game icons from game-icons.net to the Library: about 4,000 SVG icons.
plugin.longDescription: Adds a Game icons tab to the Library with about 4,000 icons from game-icons.net: weapons, potions, skills, classes and status effects. Search in English; an added icon is a black SVG on a transparent background, ready to recolor. Most icons are CC BY 3.0, so credit the author kept with each one.
source.title: Game icons
source.description: Icons from game-icons.net, most under CC BY 3.0: credit the author shown with each one. Search in English, such as sword, potion or shield.
